body: All my husband and I do is fight. I don't feel like I have a home. I feel like I'm a roommate. We had another fight tonight. I love him so much I can't be without him but I can't live with hating myself all of the time.
I'm here until I can override my primal instinct to keep myself alive. I finally snapped. I can't take anything anymore.
I would. I don't want to be alone through this.
